column7: Oracle (a) flagged RotateSecret's non-transactional version write. AUDIT-MUTATION-TX-1 made a rotation with no rotation backend, and every rollback, commit the version, the timestamp and the audit row as one transaction (internal/core/secrets.go rotateSecret), and removed the fuzz tolerance. A backend-bound rotation stays two-step by design (the upstream credential has already changed). Found by ISSUE-TRIAGE-1 (2026-10-17).
